platform: Linux x86_64, headless Chromium, disposable PostgreSQL/pgvector + Redis + MinIO + Controller + built OpenCode runtime
passed: Login through the production Vite build served by pinned nginx
Reload restores the authenticated file list from the HttpOnly refresh cookie (localStorage holds only current_workspace_id)
Native file chooser uploads a 104-byte synthetic file: POST /api/files/preflight 200, POST /api/files 201
UI download emits a real browser download; bytes and sha256 match the uploaded payload
Workspace page displays the running SKYcode runtime and opens it
OpenCode iframe loads through the runtime-origin gateway with real /global/config, /provider, /project, /session/status, /global/event 200 responses
Losing the refresh cookie fails closed: reload shows the login form and no file data
No console errors on the parent page
limitations: Fixture serves plain HTTP on localhost, so the refresh cookie is not Secure here; deployments require HTTPS.
Browser file chooser is exercised; native OS picker dialogs are not.
No external model provider is called; the runtime uses fixture configuration only.
The indexing worker is not part of this fixture, so the uploaded file stays in "processing" state.

Terminal keystrokes were not driven through the OpenCode web UI: its Add-project picker depends on /find/file results that the sandbox server returns empty, so no session/terminal can be opened from the iframe. The terminal relay itself is covered by tests/integration/test_runtime_ui_terminal.py (4 passed) against the real stack.
fixture_run: pytest tests/integration/test_full_browser.py (RUN_FULL_BROWSER=1) -> 1 passed in 253.55s; fixture removed its disposable containers/volumes/networks
harness_fixes: Browser fixture binds its API on the default bridge gateway on Linux and substitutes the literal address into the nginx template (host.docker.internal is resolved through the container resolver, bypassing /etc/hosts)

runs.result: 1 passed in 253.55s (first run) and 1 passed in 186.49s (second run)
runs.note: The fixture asserts the browser driver wrote "verified" into its completion file and then removes every disposable container/volume/network.
Real PostgreSQL/Redis/Controller/OpenCode terminal relay: direct and one-use PTY tickets, UID 10001, bounded frames.

project_picker.conclusion: The relay allows the lookup paths (RELAY_ROOTS includes find/file/project); the empty result comes from the OpenCode server scoping its search to the requested directory, so the UI cannot list sandbox folders to add as a project. Creating /home/opencode/demo (with git init) did not change the response.
